work.englishTitle: MAXQ Special Edition Vol. 9: Kim Minjeong
work.summary: Digital MAXQ Special Edition photobook featuring Korean fitness creator Kim Minjeong (김민정), known online as Min Joy (민좌이). RIDI identifies the exact Vol. 9 product as a 32-page PDF e-book dated 2024-02-05. MAXQ's publisher coverage identifies Kim as the Vol. 9 cover model; a separate MAXQ story documents her Instagram fitness content and exercise videos. Exact image overlap with her magazine or other MAXQ material has not been checked. No ISBN is listed. No cover or paid PDF is copied because reuse permission for the exact asset is unconfirmed.
